data.why: examples/quickstart.py generates an analytic synthetic line with geometry in-script via gathervis.demo.synthetic_line, so no files need to be supplied.

goals: Browse shot gathers of a pre-stack line, stepping shot by shot, to QC the acquisition
Open the Geometry tab to check source/receiver layout and CMP fold for gaps or errors
Apply a band-pass filter and AGC/trace balance to a noisy gather and inspect the result
Draw an analysis window on a gather and compute its amplitude spectrum and f-k spectrum
Pick first breaks (manually or via STA/LTA auto-pick) on a shot gather
Run velocity analysis on a CMP gather: pick a velocity on the semblance spectrum and check the moveout flattens the event

review.summary: The tree accurately captures shot browsing, geometry and fold QC, filter/gain/mute, picking and volume slicing, with screens that match. But it leaves out two workflows the README names as central, spectral analysis and CMP velocity analysis, and two tasks are served by no feature. Velocity analysis was reachable through examples/velocity_picking.py, but that was never started. It needs those fixes before filing, not a redo.
